authorization: 同意，请你自主开展研究，回答三个失败年份的主要驱动、交易当时能否识别、其他年份相似情形验证。

answer.different_year_drivers: Supported as different observed PnL/participation paths and competing public contexts; unique causal catalysts not identified
answer.known_at_decision: Strictly prior price states, original position/clock/order posture and conservatively available official notices are observable; later annual explanations are not earlier inputs
answer.portable_across_years: Analogous paths and strong counterexamples found; coarse price states and generic notice state do not establish a stable trading decision rule

annual_localization.judgment: Defensive benefit versus buyhold, insufficient net profitability and offsetting phases; no unique all-year catalyst established
annual_localization.public_context: Methanol operating disclosures and October proposed shareholder change plus financing/glass-fiber termination; dates differ, coevents not causally separated

annual_localization.judgment: Loss concentrated in second half despite positive second-half benchmark contribution; entry marking, industry-relative hold weakness and participation turns all matter
annual_localization.public_context: Public September policy transition and company disclosures; later operating margin improvement cannot be used as 2024 input
annual_localization.old_case_limit: September13 support-exit case already selected in EX033; not new independent evidence

annual_localization.judgment: June dominates original loss; early exit misses a rise, common later reentry encounters reversal; selected hold dates have large stock-minus-sector damage
annual_localization.shared_entry_limit: R/B/P all fail June17 buy and fill June19; later losing entry not a C0056-only reservation effect
annual_localization.public_context: June17 disclosure usable June18 close/June19 execution; detailed June18 selling-price statement usable June19 close/June20 execution, not before

accounting_limits: Coordinates are exact additive original HOLD PnL, not causal factor loadings or investor motive identification
Use same anchored ledger price and quantity units; keep original fees and valuations
Annual contribution uses each original account's year-opening equity, not independent filtered strategy return
Drawdowns are path-dependent; original C0056 passes seven annual drawdown targets

cross_year_price_state.fixed_definition: Previous-session external COMMON_UP/COMMON_NONUP/DIVERGENT times stock UP/NONUP; zero boundary; 20-session window; explicit unknown
key_counterexamples: 2024 COMMON_UP+STOCK_UP PLAN_BUY mean next return -2.4614%; past-only22 observations +0.2095%
2025 COMMON_UP+STOCK_UP HOLD mean next return -0.4672%; past-only166 observations +0.3328%
COMMON_NONUP+STOCK_NONUP HOLD contributes negative2024 but positive2022 and2025
cross_year_price_state.conclusion: Known classification does not imply predictable adverse outcome; observed same-state relationships change across years

fixed_notice_contrast.window: Conservative availability D through D+9 pinned sessions; no window scan
counterexamples: 2022 W1 HOLD9 days positive; original same-year contrast positive
Deleting2021 Sep/Oct episode reverses fixed pooled HOLD contrast to+0.2257pp
Deleting2022 episode loses an original required common group and stays null
2025 evidence is one episode, not three independent notice shocks
2024 notices are May and December; fixed W does not cover major September-October participation sequence
fixed_notice_contrast.interpretation: Reject simple lower immediate entry-day-return story; retain concentrated holding-risk lead, no generic warning trading component
fixed_notice_contrast.action_value_limit: A positive entry-day return does not establish buying is better than abstention over the full cycle; June19 positive day and negative cycle demonstrate this

official_narrative_review.counterevidence: Both2021 and2025 commonly state no material main-business change;2021 Feb notice also mentions methanol market price weakness. Do not label2021 profits as operating improvement and2025 losses as speculation from these documents.
official_narrative_review.unknowns: No market-expectation census, complete investor-flow identification or unique causal event effect; unmentioned company selling price remains unknown

next_priority.question: Under disclosed rapid-rise/abnormal-trading context, distinguish C0056 already-held continuation value from fresh participation value, including original H10/reservation and post-sale participation
next_priority.distinct_from_prior: Use official disclosure clock and full actual decision postures; not only EX033100 paired first-break events; do not transfer C0011 E9 action labels
next_priority.scope_limit: A next method review is recommended; no new counterfactual, model, account or phase advance is automatically authorized by this diagnostic conclusion
